notes: First verified device. Full duplex audio, all sample rates, preamp controls working. Observed serial '2019 2005 01xxxx': serial_prefix is the model group at digits 5-8 that ua_read_serial_type() matches, serial_leading is digits 1-4. Note the leading group here is 2019, which is the serial table's entry for the x8p — the leading group is not a model code and must never be matched against that table.
